fusions.name: Misleading Prick
fusions.desc: Flicks a spine that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets within 7 tiles, with a 15% chance to turn it against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Set Them Snapping
fusions.desc: Jabs up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and stunning them for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Doubled Back
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 15% while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Biding the Opening
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
